====================
client function with procedural body
====================

CREATE CLIENT FUNCTION tasks.overdue_window()
RETURNS std.ui.UI
IS
    STATE filter TEXT
        SCOPE USER
        DEFAULT '';

BEGIN
    RETURN std.ui.window(
        title => 'Overdue Tasks',
        content => std.ui.text(
            value => filter,
            placeholder => 'Filter tasks',
            on_change => filter.SET
        )
    );
END;

          (identifier))))
    body: (client_procedural_body
      (client_state_body
        (kw_is)
        (client_state_declaration
          (kw_state)
          name: (identifier)
          type: (type_spec
            (scalar_type
              (kw_text)))
          (kw_scope)
          (kw_user)
          (kw_default)

              (string_literal)))
          (semicolon))
        (kw_begin)

====================
client function with no-STATE procedural locals and assignments
====================

CREATE CLIENT FUNCTION examples.procedural(p_value TEXT)
RETURNS TEXT
IS
    LET rows TEXT := std.data.resource();
BEGIN
    LET result := AWAIT rows;
    result := result || '!';
    result := AWAIT rows;
    RETURN AWAIT rows;
END;

---

(source_file
  (create_client_function_statement
    (kw_create)
    (kw_client)
    (kw_function)
    (qualified_name
      (qualified_name
        (identifier))
      (dot)
      (identifier))
    (parameter_list
      (lparen)
      (parameter_definition
        (identifier)
        (type_spec
          (scalar_type
            (kw_text))))
      (rparen))
    (kw_returns)
    (return_type_spec
      (type_spec
        (scalar_type
          (kw_text))))
    (client_procedural_body
      (client_no_state_body
        (kw_is)
        (client_local_declaration
          (kw_let)
          (kw_rows)
          (type_spec
            (scalar_type
              (kw_text)))
          (assignment_operator)
          (client_expression
            (client_primary_expression
              (client_call_expression
                (client_call_callee
                  (identifier)
                  (dot)
                  (identifier)
                  (dot)
                  (identifier))
                (lparen)
                (rparen))))
          (semicolon))
        (kw_begin)
        (client_procedural_statement
          (client_let_statement
            (kw_let)
            (identifier)
            (assignment_operator)
            (client_await_expression
              (kw_await)
              (client_expression
                (client_primary_expression
                  (client_parameter_read
                    (kw_rows)))))
            (semicolon)))
        (client_procedural_statement
          (client_assignment_statement
            (identifier)
            (assignment_operator)
            (client_expression
              (client_expression
                (client_primary_expression
                  (client_parameter_read
                    (identifier))))
              (client_concat_operator)
              (client_primary_expression
                (string_literal)))
            (semicolon)))
        (client_procedural_statement
          (client_assignment_statement
            (identifier)
            (assignment_operator)
            (client_await_expression
              (kw_await)
              (client_expression
                (client_primary_expression
                  (client_parameter_read
                    (kw_rows)))))
            (semicolon)))
        (client_return_statement
          (kw_return)
          (client_await_expression
            (kw_await)
            (client_expression
              (client_primary_expression
                (client_parameter_read
                  (kw_rows)))))
          (semicolon))
        (kw_end)))
    (semicolon)))
